Hi, I’m Kris.

My favorite part of this work is the people. I lead by making everyone around me better, and nothing makes me prouder than watching someone I’ve worked with grow their career. It’s why team members and managers have followed me from company to company.

For your business, that means building something your own team can run and grow with. I build the customer experience end to end: the onboarding and implementation customers feel when they sign on, customer support that gets ahead of problems, and the standard operating procedures (SOPs) and tools that keep everything running behind the scenes. I specialize in the hard part, stepping into teams and processes that are broken or don’t exist yet, building what’s needed, and hiring and growing the people who run it.

AI is how I work now. I use it to build faster, more efficient workflows, but everything runs through me as the final check, so what you get is accurate.

How it works

Wherever you're starting, I meet you there.

Some businesses run on paper and sticky notes, some on spreadsheets, some on a CRM nobody uses.

  1. 1 Where we start

    Find what's breaking

    A short discovery where I learn how your business really runs today and find where it’s starting to break.

  2. 2 Stabilize

    Start lean and stop the bleeding

    I start building the operations that stop the bleeding and get you back to stable. Simple first, bigger only when you need it.

  3. 3 Build the team

    Build the team around it

    Once things are stable, I set your team up to run those operations and grow with them.

  4. 4 Hand off

    Watch it run, together

    A few weeks side by side, fixing what breaks. Then I hand it off and step back.
